typecheck-spec.//: Type-checks the SPEC corpus (packages/agent/agent-core-env/tsconfig.spec.json). Closes lane-reachability rule 6 / backlog 770c0919: a tsconfig.spec.json with no compiling target lets the spec corpus carry type errors no gate can see. The ratchet baselines the pre-existing spec errors in tools/nx-plugins/build/executors/typecheck-spec/agent-core-env.baseline.json (baselined, NOT excluded) and fails on any per-file increase or on include narrowing. Wired into test.dependsOn so nx affected -t test runs it.

test.//: Partial override — executor/cache/outputs still come from the inferred @nx/vitest target. dependsOn is replaced wholesale, so lint/^build (workspace test targetDefaults) are relisted, plus typecheck-spec so the spec corpus is gated whenever tests run (backlog 770c0919).

e2e.//: Subprocess / real-server lane (backlog 5b839b90 AC1; docs/decisions/0009-test-lanes-unit-vs-e2e.md). Runs ONLY src/**/*.e2e.ts and src/**/*.e2e.test.ts via vitest.e2e.config.ts; the unit `test` target excludes those files. Reached by the push/CI gate (`nx affected -t e2e --parallel=1`, tools/vite-plugins/e2e-globs.mjs + tools/gate/lane-gate.mjs) and by `publish`/`nx-release-publish`. Default-running: no env gate. Cached on content (`cache:true` + inputs); declares no outputs so it never restores over dist/. dependsOn mirrors the artifacts the spawned children execute (built dist of this project and its dependencies).
